title: Private Corporate Party Bus Tour of Montréal
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Montreal like never before on our exclusive 3-hour private party bus tour, perfect for corporate groups, friends, or any special occasion. Designed for up to 30 guests, this stylish ride includes non-alcoholic refreshments and hotel pick-up. Your adventure begins in Old Montreal, where cobblestone streets and 17th-century architecture set the scene. Step off to explore landmarks like Notre-Dame Basilica, Bonsecours Market, and the Old Port while your guide shares stories about the city’s French roots. Next, dive into the Plateau, a vibrant neighborhood with colorful Victorian homes, lively parks, and iconic staircases. Discover hidden murals, street art, and pass by Schwartz’s Deli, a symbol of Montreal’s culinary heritage. Finally, head up Mount Royal for a refreshing walk to the lookout, where panoramic skyline views await. With your private group, enjoy a comfortable, engaging, and unforgettable experience of Montreal’s culture and charm.
